transforms.code:
assetPath = value['assetPath'] if value.has_key('assetPath') else None
	
	return system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetPath': assetPath or 'none'}), 0)

filters = self.custom.filters
	if filters['assetId'] is None: return []
	notifications = filters['notifications']
	if not notifications.has_key('downtime') or notifications['downtime']['enabled'] == False : return []

	#Re-read when the shift or the state changes (their own tag bindings: a binding on a child of OEE/info fires whenever any
	#sibling changes, so on every count), and once a minute (868mu83yz)
	startDate = value['shiftStart'] or system.date.midnight(system.date.now())
	#Only query when what it uses has changed: the asset, the shift start, the state start or the minute (a tag binding also
	#fires when only the quality or timestamp changes)
	ms = lambda d: d.getTime() if hasattr(d, 'getTime') else d
	key = '%s|%s|%s|%s' % (self.custom.assetInfo['assetId'], ms(startDate), ms(value['stateStart']), ms(value['timeNow']) // 60000 if value['timeNow'] else None)
	if self.custom.downtimeKey == key: return self.custom.notifications.downtime
	self.custom.downtimeKey = key
	paramsDict = {'assetId': self.custom.assetInfo['assetId'], 'durationSecs': 0, 'showChanged': False, 'showDowntimeOnly': True, 'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': system.date.now()}
	return system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.event.getAssetStateEvents(paramsDict))

#Each out-of-control measure with its own rule violations: one read of every measure's outOfControl and ruleViolations,
	#every 5 seconds so a measure going out of control shows almost at once (868mtt0uw)
	measureTags = value['measureTags'] or []
	if len(measureTags) == 0: return []
	paths = []
	for tag in measureTags:
		paths += [tag['tagPath'] + '/outOfControl', tag['tagPath'] + '/ruleViolations']
	values = system.tag.readBlocking(paths)
	tags = []
	for i, tag in enumerate(measureTags):
		if values[2 * i].value:
			violations = values[2 * i + 1].value
			tags.append({'tagName': tag['tagName'], 'tagPath': tag['tagPath'], 'violations': list(violations) if violations is not None else []})
	return tags

if value['filters']['assetId'] is None: return []

	notifications = value['filters']['notifications']
	if not notifications.has_key('qualityChecks') or notifications['qualityChecks']['enabled'] == False : return []

	checks = {}

	for row in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(value['checks']):
		if (row['assetId'] != value['filters']['assetId']) or row['auto']: continue
		if row['activeState'] or row['chkShtStateName'] == 'Missed':	#Any active state (Coming Due, Due, Overdue, In Progress, ...) plus recently Missed
			checks.setdefault(row['chkShtStateName'], []).append(row)
			
	return checks

#Once a minute and when the asset changes: tool alerts don't follow counts (868mu83yz)
	filters = self.custom.filters
	if filters['assetId'] is None: return []
	notifications = filters['notifications']
	#On unless a widget turns it off: only assets with tools mounted ever have any
	if notifications.has_key('tooling') and notifications['tooling']['enabled'] == False: return []

	alerts = system.kanoa.tooling.getAlerts({'assetId': filters['assetId']})
	if alerts is None or isinstance(alerts, basestring): return []
	return system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(alerts)

#The asset's OEE/info tag: its kanoaMES OEE tags (which the module keeps for every OEE asset; the [Kanoa] Line UDT
	#isn't always there) in one document that changes whenever any of them does. Flattened to the names the Line UDT's
	#OEE folder had; dates are in milliseconds, as that binding gave them. None without an asset
	if value is None: return None
	def folder(name):
		try: return value[name]
		except: return None
	def field(values, name):
		try: return values[name]
		except: return None
	status, run = folder('Status'), folder('Current Run')
	info = {}
	for name in ['modeId', 'modeName', 'modeTypeName', 'modeColor', 'modeSourceName', 'userName', 'iconPath', 'workOrderId',
			'workOrderName', 'workOrderTitle', 'reqdQty', 'woActualQty', 'itemId', 'itemName', 'itemDescription', 'infeedUnits',
			'outfeedUnits', 'wasteUnits', 'packageCount', 'woRemainingMinutes', 'shiftId', 'shiftNameId', 'shiftName', 'shiftStart',
			'shiftEnd', 'scheduleBlockId', 'scheduleStart', 'scheduleEnd', 'stateName', 'stateStart', 'stateTypeName', 'stateColor',
			'stateTypeColor', 'stateIconPath', 'assetId']:
		info[name] = field(status, name)
	for name in ['startDate', 'durationSecs', 'runtimeSecs', 'unplannedDowntimeSecs', 'plannedDowntimeSecs', 'targetCount',
			'standardRate', 'period', 'infeedRateSecs', 'availability', 'performance', 'quality', 'infeedCount', 'outfeedCount',
			'wasteCount']:
		info[name] = field(run, name)
	#As the module works it out for the Line tags: the run's outfeed per minute, in production only
	duration, outfeed = info['durationSecs'], info['outfeedCount']
	info['outfeedRatePerMinute'] = outfeed / (duration / 60.0) if info['modeTypeName'] == 'Production' and duration and outfeed is not None else None
	info['endDate'] = None
	return info

notifications = self.view.custom.notifications
	
	tagInfo = self.view.custom.oeeTagInfo
	startDate = system.date.fromMillis(tagInfo['shiftStart']) if tagInfo['shiftStart'] else system.date.midnight(system.date.now())	
	
	instances = []
	
	if len(notifications['downtime']) > 0:
		msg = "1 Uncoded Downtime Event" if len(notifications['downtime']) == 1 else "%s Uncoded Downtime Events"%len(notifications['downtime'])
		navInfo = {
		  			"viewPath": 'kanoa/mes/asset/downtime/downtimeTable',
		  			"viewName": "Downtime Editor",
		  			"viewParams": {
									"assetId": self.view.custom.assetInfo.assetId,
									"assetPath": self.view.custom.assetInfo.assetPath,
									"endDate": system.date.now(),
									"options": {"minDurationMins": 0, "showAllStates": False,	"showChanged": 0, "showDurationSecs": False, "sortDateAsc": False},
									"startDate": startDate
									},
		  			"popup": True
				}
				
		instances.append({'value': {"bgColor": '-kcBlue-40', "icon": "material/warning", "iconColor": '--kcOrange-30', "navInfo": navInfo, "text": msg}})
	else:
		instances.append({'value': {"bgColor": '-kcBlue-40', "icon": "material/check", "iconColor": '--kcGreen-30', "navInfo": {}, "text": 'All Downtime Events Coded' }})

	
	for k,v in notifications['qualityChecks'].items():
		# The Quality Checks list the Production Counts summary opens (summaryEvents, kind checks), as a popup over this asset:
		# from the earliest of these checks' scheduled dates (a check left in progress from an earlier day included), or the
		# shift's start if that's earlier, to now. A check in it opens in the check sheet editor
		ms = lambda d: system.date.toMillis(d) if hasattr(d, 'getTime') else d
		dates = [ms(row['scheduledDate']) for row in v if row['scheduledDate'] is not None]
		since = system.date.fromMillis(min(dates + [ms(startDate)]))
		assetName = self.view.custom.assetInfo.assetName or ''
		navInfo = {
		  			"viewPath": 'kanoa/mes/analytics/widgets/productionCounts/summaryEvents',
		  			"viewName": 'Quality Checks - %s' % assetName,
		  			"viewParams": {'assetId': self.view.custom.assetInfo.assetId, 'assetName': assetName, 'startDate': since,
		  				'endDate': system.date.now(), 'kind': 'checks', 'label': None, 'match': [], 'targets': []},
		  			"popup": True
				}
		
		if len(v) > 0:
			msg = "1 Quality Check %s"%k if len(v) == 1 else "%s Quality Checks %s"%(len(v), k)
			icon = 'material/fact_check' if k in ('Coming Due', 'Due', 'In Progress') else "material/warning"
			iconColor = '--kcRed-30' if k in ('Overdue', 'Missed') else '--kcOrange-30'
			instances.append({'value': {"bgColor": '-kcBlue-40', "icon": icon, "iconColor": iconColor, "navInfo": navInfo, "text": msg}})		
		
	#The rules by their readable names, as the Measure SPC Analysis popup shows them (868mtrbyg)
	ruleInfo = system.kanoa.quality.spc.getRuleInfo() if notifications['measures'] else {}
	if not isinstance(ruleInfo, dict): ruleInfo = {}
	for measure in notifications['measures']:
		labels = [(ruleInfo.get(rule) or {}).get('label') or rule for rule in measure['violations']]
		msg = "%s measure Out-Of-Control signal detected: %s"%(measure['tagName'], ', '.join(labels))
		icon = "material/warning"
		iconColor = '--kcRed-30'
		navInfo = {
		  			"viewPath": 'kanoa/core/dbp/widgets/analytics/measureSPCAnalysis',
		  			"viewName": 'Measure SPC Analysis',
		  			"viewParams":{"tagPath": measure['tagPath']},
		  			"popup": True
				}
	
		instances.append({'value': {"bgColor": '-kcBlue-40', "icon": icon, "iconColor": iconColor, "navInfo": navInfo, "text": msg}})

	#Tools due for maintenance or over a limit (system.kanoa.tooling.getAlerts)
	try:
		tooling = notifications['tooling'] or []
	except:
		tooling = []
	for alert in tooling:
		msg = "%s is %s: %s"%(alert['toolingName'], alert['status'], alert['message'])
		iconColor = '--kcRed-30' if alert['level'] >= 2 else '--kcOrange-30'
		navInfo = {
		  			"viewPath": 'kanoa/mes/asset/operation/tooling/mountPanel',
		  			"viewName": 'Tooling',
		  			"viewParams": {'assetId': self.view.custom.assetInfo.assetId},	#Flat: the notification's click wraps it in 'value'
		  			"popup": True
				}
		instances.append({'value': {"bgColor": '-kcBlue-40', "icon": "material/build", "iconColor": iconColor, "navInfo": navInfo, "text": msg}})

	return instances
